data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding decreased during 2023 from $755.05m at 1 January 2023 to $618.18m at 31 December 2023 (a gross reduction of approximately $136.9m). The managing agent attributes movements to claims development and reinsurance recoveries and notes the inherent estimation uncertainty in IBNR and reserving. No explicit gross prioryear only reestimation amount is stated in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: The estimate of IBNR is subject to a greater degree of uncertainty than reported claims as it is based on statistical techniques of estimation applied by actuaries as outlined below.
Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.
The directors consider that the provisions for gross claims and related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated on the basis of the information currently available to them.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross claims outstanding (opening/closing) taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, gross) and converted from $'000 to millions. The report does not present an explicit single gross figure labelled 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' broken out solely for prior years; a gross claims development triangle is present but the PDF table alignment is ragged and mapping previous-diagonal values to individual underwriting years is ambiguous from the extracted text. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is not provided. Overall gross reserve release (opening vs closing) is reported above. If a definitive gross prior-year-only reestimation figure is required, manual inspection of the original formatted triangle/notes is recommended.
